title: How GPS Works, And How It Got Better Than The Designers Ever Imagined
summary: Scott Manley covers how GPS works and how civilian accuracy went from a planned 100 meters to about one meter. He explains the technology and the removal of restrictions that made this possible.
why: Recommended as a solid history and explanation of GPS, especially when GPS outages or accuracy come up.

quote.text: Scott Manley has a nice video covering the history of GPS and how it works, well worth a watch
